title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1712: Im waiting for you (3)

section.p: Su Yu wasn’t surprised. He already had similar guesses when he first heard that characters were laws. Human Emperor and Culture King had evidently not expected that humanity would decline so much that the suppressive force would be required again.
Back then, they had disabled the suppressive force for their mounts, their friends, and the myriad races on pilgrimage. That had clearly backfired on humanity.
“I understand now.”
Then, Su Yu grabbed the crying furball. He was confused. Why was the little furball still crying?
Even the white dog had stopped crying.
How weak.
“Farewell, Seniors…”
Just then, the little furball shouted, “I understand! I must be the dao of crying! I’m so sad! I can’t stop crying!”
What the hell was this?
The dao of crying?
The white dog answered seriously, “No, that’s wrong. The dao doesn’t even react to your crying. How can that be your dao?”
“But I can’t stop crying…”

“Ohh…” The white dog said apologetically, “You’re too weak. Su Yu was strong enough to break free of the effect, but you might need to keep crying for two or three days. You will be fine. Don’t worry.”
Two or three more days of crying? This time, the little furball grew even sadder. Why? Was he really so weak? Well, he was indeed quite weak. So he wasn’t the dao of crying?
Su Yu found the situation funny, but he resisted laughing. It would be rude when the white dog was still so sad.
“Farewell.”
Then, Su Yu stepped away.
After that short nap, he felt refreshed. As for the matter concerning the Time Sage, he decided to forget it. This did not concern him. Or at the very least, this matter did not concern him for now.
Helping the Time Sage? What a joke. He wasn’t even a match for Daofuses. Was he supposed to interfere in a fight between Great Dao experts?
Moments later, he vanished into the waterfall.

With Su Yu gone, the white dog looked at the book spirit and tea plant. With a fierce growl, he said, “Read! Read more! If you don’t grow stronger, I’ll feed both of you to the big guy! You’re too stupid!”

The book spirit was rendered speechless. That was applicable to the tea plant, but not him. He was a book! Fine, fine. He decided to obey since it was clear Fat Ball was losing patience. And thus, sounds of him reading filled the air.
The tea plant started listening like an obedient student. She didn’t even dare to waste her time washing herself anymore. Fat Ball was quite scary when he was angry.
With one step, Su Yu reappeared on the other side of the time waterfall.

Once again, he felt as though he had traversed worlds. He had only spent a day on the other side, but he had gained significantly. He was welcomed with a drizzle. The entire Human Realm was filled with cheers.
Feeling the drizzle on his body, Su Yu raised his brow. Was this the so-called source qi rain?
Why was it so light?

How stingy. What was Great Zhou King doing? Instead of producing a torrential rain, he had produced a drizzle like he was some romantic. With a flicker, Su Yu vanished before reappearing high in the sky.
There, Great Zhou King and a few other Invincibles were hard at work. They displayed zero enthusiasm in their current work. A source qi rain covering the entire Human Realm. This was unheard of.
Sensing Su Yu’s arrival, Great Zhou King flashed Su Yu a smile, seemingly saying that he had done as told. Wasn’t this a magnificent rain? One that would leave a mark in history?
However, Su Yu asked coldly, “Is this your so-called source qi rain? A drizzle like this?”
What nonsense was this?

Great Zhou King’s smile stiffened somewhat as he said, “This is a rain covering the entire Human Realm. We can’t make it too heavy or it will drain the entire Human Realm of its ambient source qi. A lot of Eternals had died in the Human Realm recently, but the ambient source qi still isn’t dense enough to create natural source qi rains.”
Su Yu thought about it and decided not to bicker about this. This old man was quite strong. He didn’t want to provoke this old man too much.
“Fine, fine.” Su Yu asked, “Great Zhou King, what do you think about having Great Qin King switch to the Weapon Fusion Method?”
Great Zhou King’s smile vanished. With a slight frown, he asked, “Switching to the Weapon Fusion Method?”
His frown deepened as he said, “Yes, his body has been damaged heavily, but he has been walking the dao all warriors walk. Switching now…will require him to start from scratch.”
He added, “Also, the Myriad Realms do not allow the cultivation of any other methods.”
Su Yu said, “I know. But why is the Devil Pseudo Emperor a Daofuse when he also cultivates the Three Body Method?”

“It’s different.” Great Zhou King explained, “They might use the same method, but the devils don’t walk the dao of humanity. We only walk the dao of humanity. It’s hard for us to fuse with their dao…”

Su Yu said, “But Great Qin King can cultivate the Weapon Fusion Method as well, right? He has a rich experience in cultivation, and he’s good at spears. He can try pursuing the dao of spear instead. I reckon he can improve quickly through this dao.”
Great Zhou King nodded, “The punishment from the laws is our biggest concern here. The punishment for someone like him will be quite powerful.”
Before Su Yu could say anything, Great Zhou King added, “Don’t bother offering to face the punishment for him. You can’t. It’s not possible as the punishment will only target the cultivator himself…”
Su Yu shook his head and said, “No. If I teach Great Qin King the Weapon Fusion Method, I will share his karma…”
But suddenly, Su Yu raised his brow and said, “Forget it for now. I still need to get the method from Heavendoom and the others. Perhaps it can’t even be taught anymore. Forget it. We’ll wait.”
Wait?
Great Zhou King stared at Su Yu. What were they waiting for?
Su Yu did not elaborate, but they only needed to wait until he started fusing a dao as well.
At that point, he should be able to take someone into Culture King’s Residence with the Book of Time.
Yes.
That thought solidified itself in Su Yu’s mind.

For now, he still couldn’t take anyone with him. He needed the ability to actively use the defensive power of the Book of Time. The book spirit, tea plant, and little furball were essentially special cases since they were spirits.
“Yes, I might be able to take them all in and avoid the punishment.”

A new plan took form. He could put the matter aside for now. He had to first start his dao fusion. He started to understand that cultivating characters was a much better path. As characters were laws as well, they couldn’t be prohibited by the heavenly laws as they were fellow laws.
With numerous thoughts in his mind, Su Yu turned to leave.
“Where are you going?”

Great Zhou King asked curiously. Su Yu was getting more and more mysterious nowadays. Great Zhou King felt like not even he himself had as many secrets as this guy anymore. Why was this guy acting all mysterious and unfathomable?
“I’m going to enter the Daomeld Realm.”
Su Yu did not look back as he said, “Take good care of the Human Realm, Great Zhou King. There is no need to trouble me with these minor tasks. I need to go. I also need to visit a few races.”
“You…”
Great Zhou King was rendered speechless. Was this guy leaving just like this?
“When are you coming back?”
“I don’t know.”
“What if…”
“That’s all. Great Zhou King, don’t ask what you shouldn’t ask.”
Then, Su Yu vanished into the distance.
Junior Zhou King walked over and smiled, “Did you suffer a loss?”

This elder brother of his had rarely suffered losses when talking. But Su Yu was too special. He would say all he wanted to say before leaving, not giving Great Zhou King the chance to even get a word in. It didn’t matter how good Great Zhou King was with his words. His sophistry would not work against someone like Su Yu.
Great Zhou King stared in Su Yu’s direction for a while before sighing, “That guy didn’t take the third fragment from me.”

He had thought that Su Yu would use the third fragment to lure Heavenly Overseer Marquis out, but that didn’t happen. What was Su Yu thinking? Great Zhou King looked in Starfall Mountain’s direction doubtfully. Su Yu had not stayed there for long. Did he gain anything there?
It had only been a day, and his aura had grown a lot more stable than before. But he didn’t feel much stronger than before.
“Daomeld…”
Great Zhou King muttered to himself. Had Su Yu found his path?
Su Yu moved rapidly. In no time, he reached the Dual Holy Prefecture.

There, numerous people were busy constructing the new holy land. He wasted no time and approached Zhu Tiandao and Marquis Xia, who were on the verge of fighting against each other. The two had seemingly abandoned all their work in their own prefectures to work here.
The moment Su Yu arrived, Zhu Tiandao sent him a voice transmission, “Xia Xiao’er is embezzling the funds here to fill Great Xia’s treasury!”
Marquis Xia sent him a voice transmission as well, “Zhu Number Two is corrupted! Like his elder brother, he’s stealing carrier treasures!”
Weren’t they fine with each other before?
Su Yu was left speechless.
He couldn’t be bothered to bicker and went straight to the point, “Where are the things I asked for? I need to go somewhere now.”
The two glared at each other before taking a storage ring out each. When Su Yu checked the storage rings, he rolled his eyes. What an even distribution. The two had split everything exactly in half.
What were they…fine, fine. They could do what they want.
Seeing that Su Yu was leaving right away, Marquis Xia hurriedly said, “By the way–”
“I’m busy. We’ll speak more when I return.”
Then, Su Yu vanished with a flicker.
The moment Su Yu left, Marquis Xia asked coldly, “Zhu Number Two, did you tell on me?”

“You did the same.” Zhu Tiandao sneered, “Xia Xiao’er, what do you have to compete against me? Your big face? With the unification of humanity, I believe I can be the new Culture King. I have killed Invincibles before. Have you?”

Marquis Xia was rendered completely speechless. He was furious. Damn it! So what if he had never killed Invincibles? What was the big deal about killing Invincibles? He decided that he was too mature to bicker about this.
To the side, Zhu Tiandao was chuckling smugly. Competing against him? Dream on!
“My nephew killed Invincibles before! Those could be considered my kills as well!”

Marquis Xia sighed and said, “My talent isn’t good enough. I suppose I can only rely on my nephew. My nephew is truly impressive. It’s only a matter of time before he becomes a ninth-degree Eternal. My nephew has the military under his control. My nephew…”
Zhu Tiandao interrupted the bragging, “Your nephew beat you up before.”
“My nephew…”
“Your nephew beat you up before!”
Marquis Xia’s face turned ashen with fury. Zhu Tiandao sneered. He only needed to say that one thing to win against this guy repeatedly!
Marquis Xia gnashed his teeth in fury. He had suffered a complete defeat in this verbal spar.
Damn it!
He swore he wouldn’t let this slide.
